title: Pocketwire Vault Monthly Tier Review
content:
Pocketwire Savings Vault tiers are reviewed on the first day of each calendar month, and the result applies to all of a customer's vaults at once.

## Questions answered

**When does the review take place?** On the first day of each calendar month.

**Where can a review move the customer?** All of the customer's vaults move to the highest tier whose entry requirement is met both by the linked Pocketwire Personal Account's plan and by the previous month's average combined vault balance.

**What is the previous month's average combined vault balance?** The average of the end-of-day combined vault balance over the days of the calendar month before the month in which the review falls.

**When does a tier drop?** A drop is by one tier, and only after more than the tier's tolerated number of consecutive reviews below the tier's balance to keep the tier.

## Consecutive reviews and the drop

| Tolerated consecutive reviews below | Earliest consecutive review below at which the one-tier drop can take place |
|---|---|
| 0 | The first |
| 1 | The second |
| 2 | The third |

A review at or above the balance to keep the tier ends the run of consecutive reviews below.

## Highest tier met (hypothetical customer whose vaults are on rank 1)

| Tier rank | Plan requirement met | Average balance requirement met | Both met |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| 2 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| 3 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| 4 | Yes | No | No |
| 5 | No | No | No |

The highest tier at which both requirements are met is rank 3, so the review moves all of this customer's vaults to rank 3.

## Averaging example (hypothetical figures)

The previous month had 30 days. The combined vault balance ended 10 of those days at $12000.00 and 20 of them at $6000.00. The ten days total $120000.00 and the twenty days total $120000.00; the end-of-day balances therefore total $240000.00, and that total divided by the 30 days of the month gives an average combined vault balance of $8000.00.
